mentions.name: Untether
mentions.description: A Garmin Connect IQ watch app with a required Android companion app that shifts brief phone interactions to the wrist to reduce daily phone use. It lets users do essential quick actions from the watch, reply to any Android notification, and make notes using the headphone mic and speech-to-text, keeping the phone out of sight.
mentions.problem: Dumbphones are too extreme since a smartphone is still needed for day-to-day activities like banking, so the goal is shifting 20-30 micro phone interactions per day to the wrist to reduce phone use.
mentions.audience: People who want to reduce their daily phone use without giving up their smartphone
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on <https://untether.watch>. Trying to shift 20-30 micro phone interactions to the wrist per day to ultimately reduce phone use. Dumbphones are too extreme - you need a smartphone for certain day-to-day activities (banking etc.)

The watch is a great form factor - it's got a crap screen (MIP), the ergonomics are awkward (rotate and look down), it has limited capabilities. But that's the point! Do essential quick actions and leave the phone out of site.

Requires Android companion app to do the heavy lifting. Use the (head)phone mic and STT to reply to any android notification and make notes. More features to come.

mentions.name: Untether
mentions.description: A Garmin watch app that provides a general AI assistant and queries the watch's rich sensor data, including health, physical, environmental, and location sensors. It is privacy focused, using the user's own API keys with Gemini, and makes API calls directly from the watch with no backend.
